description: REVIEWED list of files that earlier versions left in the repository and that V17.6.9 does not contain. Removed ONLY by `npm run prune-stale -- --delete` (explicit), never automatically. Source: the GitHub Actions log logs_104051351287 (54 orphaned TypeScript files reported by the orphan check + 5 failing historical test files) compared with the V17.6.8 package, which contains none of them and passes 266/266 tests without them.
